responsibility: Declares the PushBackInput interface for opening a source file, reading characters with pushback support, pushing back characters or strings, querying current line and column, controlling debug echoing, and issuing position-aware diagnostics. It provides the public contract for scanner-style reversible input on top of FIO and DynamicStrings.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface file for the GPushBackInput pair: it publishes the reversible character-input, pushback, position-query, and diagnostic entry points, while GPushBackInput.cc contains the internal stack buffers, source-position state, and actual file-reading/pushback logic.
